title: Rescinding a Signed Renewal of a Lease Term Agreement
content:
A signed renewal of a Lease Term Agreement may be rescinded by the resident without charge before it starts.

## Rescission window

A renewal may be rescinded only when the current date is no later than the renewal's signed date plus the program's rescission days. Rescission days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the renewal was signed, and the last counted day is included. The signed date and the origin of the term (a renewal) are read from the renewal term's record.

A term program with 0 rescission days has no rescission.

## Effect

A rescinded renewal leaves the expiring term as it was: without a notice to vacate it converts to month-to-month at its end, and new renewal offers are not issued again for it.

## New-lease terms

A pending new-lease term is cancelled only together with the withdrawal of its lease application.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Renewal signed | Rescission days | Last day to rescind | Rescission asked | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 June | 3 | 7 June | 7 June | May be rescinded |
| 4 June | 3 | 7 June | 8 June | May not be rescinded |
| 4 June | 5 | 9 June | 9 June | May be rescinded |
| 4 June | 0 | — | 4 June | No rescission on this program |
